meta.title.description: Title of the browser tab and the search result for this page. “Tabsend” is the product name.

meta.description.message: Tabsend sends a web page from one of your devices to another. This is the web console, a page that lists your devices and shows what you sent. Learn more at tabsend.org.
meta.description.description: Description search engines show under the title. Up to about 160 characters.

meta.noscript.message: Tabsend sends a web page from one of your devices to another. This web console needs JavaScript to run. Learn more at <link>tabsend.org</link>.
meta.noscript.description: Text for a browser with JavaScript turned off, in place of the whole page. The part in <link>…</link> is a link to the Tabsend website. “tabsend.org” is an address: keep it.
